final: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(sr.rate - o.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.rate > o.avg_rate
